scope: Read-only review of the dedicated single-job workflow candidate and its exact fixture rendering. Actual final inline was executed with bounded filesystem, clock and source doubles; actual initial bash guard was executed locally. No Mac build, inventory or CI execution was performed by this reviewer.

sourceFixture.evidenceLevel: exact local rendering; provider source and caller admission reviewed separately

preparedRuntimeCaller.evidenceLevel: reported prepared immutable identity; this caller review does not substitute for independent provider readback or fresh admission

allowedChanges: Workflow name and dedicated branch in trigger and initial guard
One fixture placeholder and updated immutable upstream helper hash
Two selected QA count literals from565 to577
One optional inventory_diagnostic_safe function and its projected upstream field

verifiedBehavior.journalBinding: The actual pinned source validator and canonical serialized byte count/SHA256 must match before a journal is published. Missing validator, missing/malformed journal or mismatched receipt yields unavailable with null journal.
verifiedBehavior.fixedProjection: Only the fixed journal keyset, ordered phase vocabulary, known module byte/hash, allowlisted error classes/fixed own codes, bounded typed SystemExit and boolean category observations survive. Messages, paths, PID/argv and unknown extra keys do not survive.
verifiedBehavior.primaryFailure: A failed inventory journal retains original global-invoke SystemExit7 and the distinct later cleanup error. A persisted inventory nonzero primary remains the published first failure across summary conflict, projection failure, late clock failure and source binding failure; result stays failed.
verifiedBehavior.unknown: Unavailable inventory/harness counters remain null. Optional journal absence or rejection does not invalidate an independently valid existing proof, and a complete journal cannot make failed inventory pass.
verifiedBehavior.guards: The real initial bash block accepts the dedicated Recovery59 branch and rejects the old Recovery58 branch and a foreign branch. Both created-push guards and unchanged origin, current-execution and source predicates remain present.
verifiedBehavior.expectedResults: The inherited real proof and typed caller gates preserve manifest SKIP and known expected FAIL independently from positive PASS; bool/float counters, unknown measurements, incomplete log, wrong selection, monitor or cleanup failures fail qualification.

executionContractPreserved.sdkAndCheckpoint: Existing exact normal unexpired official sources; no new payload or retention policy.

limitationsAndNextAdmission: Local source/bootstrap controls do not establish the exact Recovery58 Mac exception. Its private inventory traceback was not recovered; original cause remains unknown.
No Recovery59 Mac inventory, global registration count,45-record result or additional full-host/native qualification is claimed.
The prepared caller identity requires independent immutable provider readback, exact rendered workflow and one-path ancestry comparison, and unchanged non-dedicated workflow trigger census.

Immediately before a single authorized activation, require unused branch/head runs, no owned active or queued overlap and fresh normal SDK/checkpoint origin, producer, expiry, size and digest admission. Expired sources must fail closed.
